name: Andhra Pradesh Buildings SoR 2025-26 (Civil, Water Supply & Sanitary, Electrical)
department: Committee of Chief Engineers — Buildings SoR, Office of the Engineer-in-Chief (R&B) Buildings & RSW, Government of Andhra Pradesh
source_ref: Government of Andhra Pradesh, Buildings SoR 2025-26, finalised by the Committee of Chief Engineers on 16.04.2025, communicated vide Procs.No.20938/SOR/DCE(B)/EE(B)/DEE(B)/AEE/2021 dt 06.05.2025. Copy obtained from a non-government host (img1.wsimg.com) — verify against the R&B department copy.
notes: Building item, material (MAT-) and labour (LAB-) rates as printed. Labour, common material/work items, conveyance and hire charges are in the separate Common SoR 2025-26, not included here. Basic labour/material rates (CFMS codes LAB-/MAT-) added from AP Panchayat Raj Engineering 'Labour Rates and Conveyance 2024-25' (CSSR 2024-25, from 01.07.2024), https://pred.ap.gov.in/PRED/SSR.aspx — one year older than the Buildings SoR. Cement and reinforcement steel are NOT printed by AP (monthly rate fixed by the Sub-Committee): enter them on the estimate.
